title: Protesters interrupt Donald Trump rally in Wichita

tea.why: Protesters voiced opposition to Donald Trump during his midterm campaign rally in Wichita.
tea.want: Specific policy demands were not detailed by the sources, aside from vocal opposition.
tea.changed: Oct 20: Multiple protesters interrupted Donald Trump's rally in Wichita, Kansas.

summary: On October 20, 2026, several protesters repeatedly interrupted a midterm campaign rally held by Donald Trump in Wichita, Kansas. The event, organized in support of Senator Roger Marshall, saw back-to-back disruptions from at least six individuals who shouted from the audience. Security personnel escorted the hecklers out of the arena. Donald Trump dismissed the demonstrators as paid protesters and spoke over them as they voiced their opposition. The disruptions took place amid a tight political race and falling presidential approval ratings ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
response: Security personnel escorted the protesters out of the arena, while Donald Trump dismissed them as paid agitators and mocked their remarks.

updates.text: At least six protesters interrupted Donald Trump's campaign rally in Wichita, Kansas.
